headline: Congress in pro forma holding pattern — Senate and House both in skeleton-crew sessions Tuesday with no votes, no floor action, nothing on the agenda.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session for 24 seconds Tuesday afternoon before adjourning. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House convened briefly at 1:30 p.m. and adjourned after three minutes with no votes or floor action. Fifteen bills and one resolution were introduced for the record.
